input.query: SELECT variant, count(*) AS n, min(assigned_date) AS first_assignment, max(assigned_date) AS last_assignment, avg(conv_14d::INTEGER) AS conversion_rate, avg(margin_60d_eur) AS margin_per_assigned_user_60d, sum(margin_60d_eur)/nullif(sum(conv_14d::INTEGER),0) AS net_margin_per_converter_60d, sum(margin_60d_eur + bonus_cost_eur)/nullif(sum(conv_14d::INTEGER),0) AS pre_bonus_margin_per_converter_60d, sum(bonus_cost_eur) AS bonus_total FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id = 'topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY variant
